note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; the steps are generic items of the given scenario as supplied, never a requirement of any law. Times are fictional labels. "Formality provided" and "formality pending" are supplied statuses only — a pending state is not a deficiency; no formality rule, no writing, notarial or registration requirement, no consequence and no jurisdiction is stated.

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long names, references, document texts, step rows (three per document), time labels and context labels, all five events; long before and after labels; the pending ring on Party A's document. Capped (standing rule item 20; pre-cap value in production/scratch/contract-formation-09/LAW-0476.stress.precap.json): the after value only, 'Document A: formality pending (supplied)' (40 characters) → 'Formality pending for A (supplied)' (34). True driver: the lens on the connection's station at 1:1 — the 40-character after value takes a third line in the station's label chip, the receipt-plus-connection crop then grows taller than its printed content and the lens's fill drops under 0.40 (1080x1080: lensSparse, layout flagged); at 34 characters the crop's content fill is ≥ 0.40 (text 16.1 px, head box 81.1 px model). The after value is still longer than its baseline counterpart (31 characters) and every count is kept (3 + 3 steps, 5 events, one shared position).
